name: Survey tile in Taurus
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 0.1 degrees south of the ecliptic in Taurus, imaged by SPHEREx 17 times in 5 visits over 47 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 34 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 47 hours starting 2026-02-20, at wavelengths from 0.75 to 4.95 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
